result.description:
Global Vision Recruitment on behalf of Jeay Sindh Pty Ltd T/A South Seoul Kelvin Grove

Date Posted: 10th July 2026

Position: Retail Manager

Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 per annum plus 12% Superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full Time

Location: 2 Carraway Street Kelvin Grove QLD 4059

Experience required: Minimum 1 year experience relevant to the role

About Us

South Seoul is a vibrant and fast-growing Korean fried chicken and rice bowl restaurant that brings authentic flavours with a modern twist. We pride ourselves on using high-quality ingredients, innovative recipes, and friendly service to deliver a standout dining experience. With a loyal customer base and a focus on consistency, quality, and teamwork, South Seoul continues to make its mark as a go-to destination for Korean street food lovers in Australia.

Position:

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to oversee the daily operations of South Seoul, ensuring smooth service, excellent customer experiences, and consistent business performance. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, operational know-how, and a passion for hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage daily store operations to ensure South Seoul runs efficiently during peak dining periods, maintaining high standards of food presentation, service quality, and cleanliness.

• Determine product mix and stock levels based on seasonal menu items, customer preferences, and delivery patterns—ensuring our most popular dishes, such as Korean fried chicken and rice bowls, are always available fresh.

• Formulate and implement purchasing and pricing policies that align with South Seoul’s brand promise of premium quality at accessible prices, balancing profitability with customer satisfaction.

• Promote and advertise the restaurant’s offerings through local marketing campaigns, social media engagement, and community partnerships to strengthen South Seoul’s visibility and attract repeat customers.

• Oversee customer interactions and service delivery, ensuring that every meal reflects South Seoul’s friendly, welcoming, and authentic Korean dining culture.

• Maintain accurate records of stock, sales, and financial transactions to support data-driven decision-making and cost management.

• Prepare and monitor budgets, identifying opportunities to improve performance while managing food and labour costs efficiently.

• Recruit, train, and develop team members who embody South Seoul’s values of teamwork, respect, and enthusiasm for great food.

• Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and workplace health standards, upholding South Seoul’s reputation for cleanliness and consistency.

Qualifications

• Tertiary qualification in Retail Management, Business Administration, or Hospitality Management (preferred but not required)

Skills & Requirements

• Minimum of 1 year experience in a supervisory or management role within the food or retail industry.

• Proven success in team leadership, operations, and customer service excellence.

• Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to motivate and manage a diverse team.

• Sound knowledge of inventory control, budgeting, and sales analysis.

• Passion for Korean cuisine and the hospitality industry.

• Familiarity with WHS and food safety compliance standards.

• Proficiency in POS systems, rostering, and operational reporting.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take the next step in your hospitality career and help South Seoul deliver unforgettable dining experiences, send your resume to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Join us and be part of the South Seoul story—where Korean flavours meet Australian hospitality.

Salung Thai Café is a full-service restaurant providing cosy dining environment, fresh ingredients and friendly service. We are serving Thai street food with an option of specific diet such as vegan, vegetarian, gluten free and more.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced and motivated Restaurant Manager to join our leadership team. Ready to stop reporting on the business and start influencing it?

Some finance roles are all about producing reports. This isn't one of them.

At MiHaven, we're looking for a Financial Controller who wants a seat at the table. Someone who sees beyond the numbers, challenges the status quo and isn't afraid to ask, "There has to be a better way."

You'll work directly with our Directors, lead a small finance team and become the commercial voice behind some of our biggest business decisions.

If you're looking for a role where you can genuinely influence the future of a growing business, not just report on it,you've just found it!

The Opportunity

It's not your typical Financial Controller position. Yes, you'll oversee the finance function. Yes, you'll manage budgets, forecasts, cash flow and reporting.

But you'll also be responsible for helping shape the financial success of major construction projects, providing the commercial insight that keeps projects on track and ensuring every dollar works harder for the business.

We're looking for someone who's curious. Someone who challenges. Someone who sees opportunities where others see spreadsheets. You can check out the day to day via the PD which is located on our careers page.

About You

You might already be a Financial Controller. Or perhaps you're the Finance Manager who's already doing the work but hasn't been given the title. Either way, you'll bring:

    Strong commercial acumen
    Exceptional financial reporting and forecasting skills
    Confidence leading people and holding your team accountable
    The ability to influence operational leaders
    A proactive mindset focused on improving systems and processes
    The confidence to speak up, challenge ideas and contribute strategically

Construction experience would be great,but it's not essential.

Commercial thinking is.
Why you'll love this role

This is one of those rare opportunities where your contribution won't disappear into layers of management.

Your work will be seen.

Your ideas will be heard.

Your decisions will make a difference.

You'll enjoy:

    Negotiable salary based on experience
    Option to include company vehicle and/or fuel card as part of remuneration package
    On-site parking
    Full-time office-based role in Cairns
    Genuine autonomy
    Direct access to the Directors
    The opportunity to build something better

If you're ready to step into a role where you'll influence decisions not just report on them, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, connect with our Recruitment Business Partner Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

To apply for this job go to: https://mihavenjobs.recruitmenthub.com.au/Jobs

result.description:
Our esteemed client, VK Windows and Doors, is a family-owned Australian manufacturer and supplier of premium aluminium windows and doors for residential, commercial, and architectural projects. Based in Kilmore, Victoria, the company is committed to delivering high-quality, energy-efficient, and durable products, backed by expert craftsmanship and customer-focused service. With a strong emphasis on innovation, reliability, and custom solutions, the business helps create modern, functional, and stylish spaces across Australia.

VK Windows and Doors is currently seeking a skilled Carpenter to join their growing team. The successful candidate will follow blueprints and building plans, shape or cut materials to exact measurements with hand tools or power saws, and operate, maintain, and sharpen carpentry tools. Install structures or fixtures, including windows, doors, frames, flooring, trim, and hardware, using hand and power tools. 

The annual salary for this position is $80,000 to $85,000 plus superannuation.

This position is offered on a minimum 2-year contract with the possibility of further extension.

Responsibilities include:

•	Install structures or fixtures, such as windows, doors, frames, floorings, trim, or hardware, using hand or power tools.

•	Level and help erect the build framework.

•	Utilise chisels, planes, saws, drills, and sanders to repair and erect structures.

•	Join materials with nails, screws, staples, or adhesives.

•	Examines work to make sure it meets specifications.

•	Install door handles, locks, hardware, flooring underlay, insulating material and other fixtures.

•	Follow blueprints and building plans to meet the needs of clients.

•	Shape or cut materials to specified measurements, using hand tools, machines, or power saws.

•	Operate, maintain, and sharpen carpentry tools and equipment.

•	Maintain building interiors and exteriors.

•	Prepare cost estimates for clients or employers.

•	Estimate height, width, length, and other proportions using levels, rules and framing squares.

•	Measure and mark cutting lines on materials, using a ruler, pencil, chalk, and marking gauge.

•	Select and order the material and timber for the projects and prepare the layouts.

•	Work with materials such as wood, plastic, fibreglass, or drywall.

•	Assemble prepared wood to form structures and fittings ready to be installed.	

•	Follow established safety rules and regulations and maintain a safe and clean environment.

Tools & Equipment:

•	Measuring and marking out – retractable tape measure, wind-up tape measures, scale rule, folding rule, etc.

•	Squares and bevels – try square, mitre square, sliding bevel, combination square.

•	Gauges: marking gauge, mortise gauge, cutting gauge.

•	Knives, scribes and pencils – marking knife, utility knife, scribe, Carpenter’s pencil, drawing pencil.

•	Traditional hand saws – traditional hand saws, rip saw, crosscut saw, panel saw, hard point saw, back saws, etc.

•	Hammers – claw hammer, Warrington hammer, club hammer, sledgehammer.

•	Other equipment includes – screwdrivers, planes, chisels, files, rasps, drills, clamps, levelling tools and power tools such as drills, saws, sanders, planes, routers, trimmers and nail guns etc.

Qualifications: 
 
•	Must have a minimum of one to two (1-2) years of experience in a similar setting.

•	Should have at least a Certificate III in Carpentry.

•	Ability to communicate well in spoken and written English.
